notes: Flagged unit לְ + בַד + מִן → *besides* checked: one English word carries the adverbial לְ, the *apart* of בַד and the separative sense of מִן, no morpheme owns a part of it, and the three are contiguous, so rule 30's one-rendering condition holds and rule 22's closing paragraph forbids marking מִן unrepresented. Retained as indivisible; the competing reading is named in the unit note.
*a great many*: the alternative division gives *great many* to הַרְבֵּה and leaves מְאֹד unrepresented, but the ASV plainly spends *great* on the intensifier.
עָרֵי הַפְּרָזִי: the single written *the* goes to the article on the rectum, rule 29.
